title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass as it officially graduates from beta, delivering robust capabilities to all users.

title: Powerful File Management in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage and customize how images, PDFs, and other files appear within your content, providing you with unparalleled control and flexibility.

title: Explore Our Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap offers a transparent look into our progress, showcasing recently completed features, upcoming developments, and exciting plans on the horizon.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and efficient workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, visually integrated, and fully draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Collaborate with unparalleled ease and clarity thanks to significant enhancements to our real-time editing experience.

title: Smarter Sharing and Enhanced Collaboration
summary: Now, effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, as we've enhanced the visibility and utility of every shared item to bring your network closer.

title: Noeko Goes Global: Expanded Language Options
summary: We're thrilled to announce comprehensive support for international languages, making Noeko more accessible and user-friendly for everyone around the world.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and transparency to shape the project's future.

title: Dynamic Filters for Your Visual Knowledge Map
summary: Our enhanced knowledge graph allows you to effortlessly filter by tags, time, and shared items, transforming how you discover and connect your information.

title: Discover and Organize with Advanced Search and Custom Collections
summary: Our enhanced search experience empowers you to precisely filter and sort your knowledge, effortlessly creating and saving custom collections for instant access to your most relevant information.

title: Interactive Content Views
summary: We're launching new, flexible ways to view and interact with your connected notes, empowering you to better organize information and structure your thoughts.

title: Introducing Noeko Premium: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Noeko is preparing to launch a range of new paid plans and the much-anticipated self-hosting option, empowering you with greater flexibility and control over your data and team features.

title: Elevated Visual Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade as we refine our existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new styles to personalize your experience.

title: More Accurate Welcome Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and delightful welcome on your homepage with greetings that truly reflect the time of day.

title: Instant Tag Organization
summary: Manage your tagged items with unprecedented ease, allowing you to quickly unapply tags and take other key actions without ever leaving your tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your knowledge in one place.
